why_were_keys_missing: Intentional carve-out, NOT corruption. On 2026-04-18 a c2-v1 minimal runtime-gate JSON was created at ~/anima/anima/config/consciousness_laws.json, replacing the v6 path the .py loader prefers. The original v6 corpus was preserved at ~/anima/config/consciousness_laws.json (one directory up) but the .py loader was never updated to reflect the dual-schema reality. Hard-fail _DATA[k] accesses for v6-only keys then crashed when c2-v1 was loaded.
restoration_source: Not restored — v6-only keys are intentionally absent in c2-v1. Loader now schema-aware: SCHEMA_VERSION + V6_ONLY_KEYS_AVAILABLE flags expose the carve-out to consumers. Empty {} returned for v6-only sections in c2-v1 deployments.
